transcript:
Next, I will explain the difference between the sewing line type by another small case.
First, create a square board to make it flat and simulated on the ground.
Cut a board to the outer layer.
Copy and paste the current board.
You can see that the pattern is TURN.
We manually change one of them to CUSTOM ANGLE.
You can notice that after changing to CUSTOM ANGLE, the effect of the sewing line folding angle will automatically expand.
There is no pressure before this.
Next, we select the board and apply positive and negative pressure according to the direction of the pattern.
If the direction of the pattern is facing the outside, use the positive pressure.
If the direction of the pattern is facing the inside, use the negative pressure.
This is because the positive pressure is from the inside to the outside, and the negative pressure is from the outside to the inside.
You can see that the effect of setting the sewing line as CUSTOM ANGLE and TURN will be significantly different.
After opening the surface of the thick pattern, TURN will also have an obvious folding effect.
The value of the bending strength of the fabric will also affect it.
The harder the fabric, the more obvious the sewing line type and folding angle effect will be.
The fabric used at the time was a relatively hard leather.
Now we switch it to a softer default fabric.
After simulation, we can see that the shape of the two pillows will be similar.
But the performance at the seam of the sewing line is still different.
The sewing line is the same as the sewing line at the beginning.
The sewing line is the same as the sewing line at the end.
The sewing line that is shown as CUSTOM ANGLE is the sewing line effect of the hair line.
And TURN is two pieces of pattern.
So there will be an obvious layer relationship.
You need to remember that torrents will calculate the conflict thickness of two panels and the thickness of the fabric, so there will be obvious gaps.
Thanks for watching!
summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer Tips Sharing [Clothing Details Edition] Update P18 ## Introduction In this section, I will explain the difference between the sewing line types using a small case study. ## Creating a Flat Simulation First, create a square board to make it flat and simulate it on the ground. 1. Cut a board to the outer layer. 2. Copy and paste the current board. You can see that the pattern is set to **TURN**. We will manually change one of them to **CUSTOM ANGLE**. ## Effects of CUSTOM ANGLE After changing to **CUSTOM ANGLE**, you will notice that the effect of the sewing line folding angle will automatically expand. There is no pressure applied before this adjustment. ### Applying Pressure Next, we select the board and apply positive and negative pressure according to the direction of the pattern: - If the direction of the pattern is facing outward, use **positive pressure**. - If the direction of the pattern is facing inward, use **negative pressure**. This distinction is crucial because positive pressure is directed from the inside to the outside, while negative pressure is directed from the outside to the inside. ## Comparing Sewing Line Effects You can observe that the effects of setting the sewing line as **CUSTOM ANGLE** and **TURN** will be significantly different. After opening the surface of the thick pattern, **TURN** will also exhibit an obvious folding effect. The value of the bending strength of the fabric will influence this outcome; the harder the fabric, the more pronounced the sewing line type and folding angle effect. ### Fabric Comparison The fabric used during the demonstration was a relatively hard leather. Now, we will switch it to a softer default fabric. After simulation, we can see that the shape of the two pillows will be similar. However, the performance at the seam of the sewing line will still differ. The sewing line remains consistent from the beginning to the end: - The sewing line shown as **CUSTOM ANGLE** represents the sewing line effect of the hairline. - **TURN** consists of two pieces of pattern, resulting in an obvious layer relationship. ## Important Considerations It is important to remember that **torrents** will calculate the conflict thickness of two panels and the thickness of the fabric, leading to noticeable gaps. ## Conclusion Thanks for watching! ```
